title: SC-MT004-InteractiveStdioInfra

scope.summary:
GOAL: Extend the CLI-bridge process layer with a BIDIRECTIONAL attached-stdio contract so a spawned agent CLI can be kept alive and written to (steer/interrupt frames on stdin) while its stdout/stderr keep streaming through the existing StreamingPipeReader machinery. Today the contract is hard-locked to one-shot: sandbox/adapter.rs AttachedStdioContract::validate() (src/backend/handshake_core/src/sandbox/adapter.rs lines 91-101) REJECTS anything except null_stdin_piped_output(), and the CLI bridge passes exactly that at official_cli_bridge.rs line 2303 (spawn_attached_child) from LiveCliSpawner::spawn (line 2425). This MT lifts that restriction with an explicit second contract variant while preserving the legacy null-stdin one-shot mode verbatim, and keeps ProcessOwnershipLedger fail-closed semantics unchanged (START row immediately after pid capture, STOP row on EVERY exit path — the normative comment block at official_cli_bridge.rs lines 2439-2453).

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) sandbox/adapter.rs — add AttachedStdioContract::piped_stdin_piped_output() and extend validate() to accept EXACTLY the two blessed contracts; (b) sandbox/handshake_native.rs — map AttachedStdioMode::Pipe on stdin to Stdio::piped() and surface the child stdin handle on the attached process (today the spawn impl at line 114 region only wires stdout/stderr; the invalid-stdio negative test at line 385 must be updated to a still-invalid combination, e.g. stdin=Pipe stdout=Null); (c) sandbox/ledger_decorator.rs — pass the stdio contract through unchanged (line 172 region); (d) official_cli_bridge.rs — add take_stdin() on GuardedCliChild (beside take_stdout at line 1872), a StdinWriterHandle bounded-writer abstraction, a new OfficialCliBridgeError::StdinWrite variant, and a spawn_attached_child_interactive path that passes the new contract through spawn_attached_blocking (line 1498); (e) new test file src/backend/handshake_core/tests/agent_sessions_stdio_tests.rs. NO changes to the one-shot spawn() path.

SPEC CATALOG:

- sandbox/adapter.rs: pub const fn piped_stdin_piped_output() -> Self { stdin: Pipe, stdout: Pipe, stderr: Pipe }. validate(self, adapter_id) accepts null_stdin_piped_output OR piped_stdin_piped_output; every other combination keeps the existing typed SandboxAdapterError::SpawnFailed rejection (update the error message to name both blessed contracts).
- sandbox/handshake_native.rs: in the attached-spawn implementation, when spec stdio.stdin == Pipe use std::process::Stdio::piped() and store the taken child stdin (Option<std::process::ChildStdin>) on the returned AttachedSandboxProcess so GuardedCliChild can take it exactly once; when Null keep Stdio::null(). Windows note: ChildStdin on Windows is a pipe HANDLE owned by the Job-Object-contained child; closing it delivers EOF — that is the graceful-shutdown lever MT-005 uses.
- official_cli_bridge.rs additions:
  - impl GuardedCliChild { fn take_stdin(&mut self) -> Result<std::process::ChildStdin, OfficialCliBridgeError> } — single-take like take_stdout (line 1872); second take is a typed error.
  - pub struct StdinWriterHandle { tx: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<StdinFrame>, writer_join: std::thread::JoinHandle<StdinWriterExit> } — a DEDICATED writer std::thread (matching the crate rule that blocking IO never runs on a tokio worker — see the cli_bridge_runtime.rs comment at lines 676-679) that owns ChildStdin and drains a BOUNDED channel (pub const STDIN_WRITER_CHANNEL_CAP: usize = 64).
  - pub enum StdinFrame { JsonLine(serde_json::Value), Close } — JsonLine is serialized with serde_json::to_string (guaranteed no interior raw newline: serde_json escapes \n inside strings), then written as bytes + b"\n" + flush() PER LINE (JSONL framing, UTF-8, flush-per-line so the CLI sees each frame immediately); Close (or sender drop) closes ChildStdin -> EOF.
  - pub struct StdinWriterExit { pub frames_written: u64, pub last_error: Option<String> }.
  - impl StdinWriterHandle: pub async fn write_frame(&self, frame: StdinFrame) -> Result<(), OfficialCliBridgeError> (maps channel-full after a bounded try/timeout to StdinWrite backpressure error — NEVER unbounded buffering; maps channel-closed to StdinWrite "writer thread exited"); pub fn close_and_join(self, deadline: Duration) -> StdinWriterExit.
  - new error variant: #[error("CLI stdin write failed: {reason}")] StdinWrite { reason: String } on OfficialCliBridgeError (enum at line 111).
  - fn spawn_attached_child_interactive(&self, config, rendered: CliLaunchPlan-args, invocation) -> Result<GuardedCliChild, OfficialCliBridgeError> — identical to spawn_attached_child (lines ~2200-2314) except it passes AttachedStdioContract::piped_stdin_piped_output() at the line-2303 call site equivalent; factor the shared body into a private fn spawn_attached_child_with_stdio(&self, ..., stdio: AttachedStdioContract) so the two paths cannot drift, with spawn_attached_child delegating with null_stdin_piped_output() — the existing production-source guard test at line 2970 (asserts the literal "AttachedStdioContract::null_stdin_piped_output()" appears) must keep passing.
  - pub struct InteractiveCliChild { pub pid: u32, pub stdin: StdinWriterHandle, pub stdout_reader: StreamingPipeReader (via the existing drain_streaming_pipe at line 1742), pub stderr_reader: StreamingPipeReader, guarded: GuardedCliChild } with pub fn terminate_and_collect(&mut self, reason: &str) -> Option<ExitStatus> delegating to GuardedCliChild (line 1928) — MT-005 supervises this.
  - pub fn spawn_interactive(&self, config: &CliBridgeConfig, invocation: &CliInvocationContext, model_name: &str) -> Result<InteractiveCliChild, OfficialCliBridgeError> on LiveCliSpawner — the interactive sibling of spawn (line 2425): reserve_process_lifecycle (line 2357) -> spawn_attached_child_interactive -> UNCONDITIONAL ledger START via attributed_spawn_meta + attach_durable_lifecycle (lines 2374-2400, fail-closed: START registration failure kills the child) -> take stdin/stdout/stderr -> return InteractiveCliChild. NOTE: no prompt argv rendering with a user prompt — interactive sessions receive the prompt as the FIRST stdin frame; args come from config.args_template with {prompt} substituted by the transport-required stream flags at the adapter layer (this MT only requires that spawn_interactive does NOT demand a prompt parameter).
- LEDGER INVARIANT (normative, unchanged): every interactive spawn produces exactly one START row (engine_kind=OfficialCliBridge) at pid capture and exactly one STOP row at terminal collection on every path (normal EOF exit, kill, writer failure, startup failure after pid) — same fail-closed rule as the one-shot comment block (lines 2439-2453).

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Read the cited regions first: sandbox/adapter.rs 67-160, sandbox/handshake_native.rs spawn impl around line 114 and negative test at 385, ledger_decorator.rs 160-200, official_cli_bridge.rs 1490-1560 (spawn_attached_blocking), 1660-1760 (StreamingPipeReaders/drain_streaming_pipe), 1860-1960 (GuardedCliChild), 2200-2530 (spawn_attached_child + spawn + ledger paths), 2960-2980 (source guard test).
2. Extend AttachedStdioContract + validate(); update the handshake_native invalid-stdio negative test to a combination that remains invalid; run existing sandbox tests.
3. Wire stdin piping through handshake_native.rs attached spawn and the ledger_decorator passthrough; expose take-once stdin on the attached process type.
4. Refactor spawn_attached_child into spawn_attached_child_with_stdio + two thin wrappers; verify the L2970 source-guard test still passes.
5. Implement StdinWriterHandle + StdinFrame + writer thread (bounded channel cap 64, write+flush per line, exit report); add the StdinWrite error variant.
6. Implement spawn_interactive with the full ledger fail-closed sequence.
7. Author tests/agent_sessions_stdio_tests.rs: (a) contract validation matrix — both blessed contracts accepted, stdin=Pipe/stdout=Null rejected; (b) JSONL framing unit test — frames with embedded newlines/UTF-8 multibyte content serialize to exactly one line each, flush-per-line observed via a captured pipe; (c) real-child round trip with a tiny stdin-echo counterparty (cmd /c findstr or a rust test helper bin): write 3 JsonLine frames, read them back on stdout via StreamingPipeReader, Close -> child exits 0, terminate_and_collect reaps; (d) backpressure test — writer blocked (child not reading) fills the 64-cap channel and write_frame returns typed StdinWrite backpressure, never unbounded growth; (e) ledger test — spawn_interactive against a stub records START and STOP rows on both normal-exit and kill paths (reuse the existing in-memory LedgerBatcher test pattern).
8. cargo build + clippy + full official_cli_bridge test suite green (no regression on one-shot).
forbidden_paths: src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/cloud/cli_bridge_runtime.rs (one-shot streaming runtime untouched; MT-005+ consume the new seam)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/sandbox/windows_native_jail/** (its internal null-stdin probe at adapter.rs:1412 stays as-is)
acceptance_criteria: AttachedStdioContract::piped_stdin_piped_output() exists; validate() accepts exactly the two blessed contracts and rejects all others with the typed SandboxAdapterError — proven by the validation matrix test.

Legacy one-shot path unchanged: LiveCliSpawner::spawn still uses null_stdin_piped_output() and the existing source-guard test (official_cli_bridge.rs:2970 region) still passes; full pre-existing official_cli_bridge test suite green.
GuardedCliChild::take_stdin is take-once with a typed second-take error, mirroring take_stdout.
StdinWriterHandle: dedicated writer std::thread, bounded mpsc cap 64, JSONL framing (serde_json line + \n), UTF-8, flush per line — proven by framing + round-trip tests.
Backpressure is typed: a full writer channel yields OfficialCliBridgeError::StdinWrite, never unbounded buffering — proven by test.
Close/drop of the writer closes child stdin (EOF) and close_and_join returns StdinWriterExit with frames_written — proven by the echo round-trip (child exits 0 on EOF).

spawn_interactive records an UNCONDITIONAL ledger START row after pid capture (fail-closed: START failure kills the child) and a STOP row on every exit path — proven by ledger tests on normal-exit and kill paths.
spawn_interactive takes no prompt argument (prompt arrives as the first stdin frame at the adapter layer).
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake_core agent_sessions_stdio --nocapture 2>&1 | tee /tmp/mt004_run.txt && grep -E 'test result: ok' /tmp/mt004_run.txt
cargo test -p handshake_core official_cli_bridge --nocapture 2>&1 | grep -E 'test result: ok'
expected_tests: stdio contract validation matrix (2 accepted, others rejected)
JSONL framing + flush-per-line + UTF-8 multibyte proof
real echo-child round trip: 3 frames in, 3 lines out, EOF exit 0, reap proven
ledger START/STOP rows on normal-exit and kill paths
implementation_notes: The refactor-to-shared-body rule exists because the ledger fail-closed comment block (L2439-2453) is the MT-127-remediation invariant; duplicating the spawn body would eventually fork the invariant. One body, two stdio contracts.

serde_json string escaping is what makes JSONL framing safe: a steer message containing raw newlines serializes to \n inside the JSON string, so one frame is always exactly one line. The framing test must include a multi-line steer text to pin this.

Do not add tokio::process here: the whole CLI-bridge layer is std::process + dedicated threads by design (blocking poll loop must not run on tokio workers — cli_bridge_runtime.rs L676-679); the writer thread follows the same discipline.

Windows kill semantics: terminate_and_collect delegates to the sandbox adapter which owns process-TREE termination (Job Object); MT-005 builds graceful-stop (stdin EOF first, then tree kill) on top of exactly these two levers.

HBR-QUIET: the spawned interactive child inherits the existing attached-sandbox containment — hidden window, no foreground focus (HBR-QUIET-001/002); ownership metadata via attributed_spawn_meta (HBR-QUIET-003).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless process-transport infrastructure; observable via ProcessOwnershipLedger rows and MT-009 bus events; operator surfaces arrive with the GUI family.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Internal transport seam with no operator-callable command; MT-007 documents the session lifecycle surface it powers.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: internal_diagnostics (may be typed DEFERRED if the internal-diagnostics tier is not yet shipped for agent_sessions)
palmistry (may be typed DEFERRED if palmistry wiring is not yet shipped for agent_sessions)
risk_if_missed: No bidirectional transport exists: sessions stay one-shot, steering/interrupt/resume are impossible, and the adapter families have no seam to build on — the entire WP-017 session runtime is blocked.

risks: RISK-1: Unattributed long-lived child — an interactive spawn path that skips or reorders the ledger START registration leaves a live agent process invisible to reclaim (exactly the MT-122/MT-127 class the one-shot path was hardened against).
RISK-2: Deadlock on full pipes — child stops reading stdin while we block writing, or we stop reading stdout while the child blocks writing; classic bidirectional-pipe deadlock hangs the session.
RISK-3: Frame corruption — hand-rolled framing lets an embedded newline split one steer into two bogus JSON lines, silently corrupting the transport protocol.
RISK-4: One-shot regression — refactoring the shared spawn body subtly changes null-stdin behavior (timeout, reap, STOP rows) and breaks every existing CLI-bridge caller.

RISK-5: Sandbox contract widening — validate() accidentally accepts arbitrary stdio combinations, allowing a future caller to spawn with inherited stdio and leak the operator console into an agent process.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): spawn_interactive reuses reserve_process_lifecycle + attach_durable_lifecycle verbatim (fail-closed kill on START failure); ledger tests assert START+STOP on normal and kill paths.

CTRL-2 (RISK-2): stdin writes go through the bounded channel + dedicated thread with typed backpressure (never block a tokio worker); stdout/stderr are ALWAYS drained by StreamingPipeReader from spawn; backpressure test pins the behavior.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): serde_json-only serialization (escapes newlines) + framing test with multi-line UTF-8 payload.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): shared-body refactor keeps two thin wrappers; the existing L2970 source-guard test plus the full pre-existing official_cli_bridge suite are named proof targets.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): validate() enumerates exactly two blessed contracts; validation-matrix test asserts a still-invalid combination is rejected.
